natural_language_statement:
Call a subset of positive integers admissible if it contains no $a<b<c$ satisfying $a(b+c)=bc$, equivalently $1/a=1/b+1/c$. Let $S$ be admissible and supported in $\{1,\ldots,732\}$, and let $n\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $732\leq n\leq734$. Define $L_n(S)$ to agree with $S$ at all $x\leq732$ and to select exactly those of 733 and 734 that are at most $n$. Then

$$
L_n(S)\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\},\qquad L_n(S)\text{ is admissible}.
$$

This endpoint extension supplies witnesses for the exact-maximum transfers at 733 and 734.
